source: The events are the original game's, from the fan wikis and the dated news rows behind each client_areas.json season. (R) The switch itself is ours: run_on_real_dates true follows the season dates as the live game's events did; false starts nothing by date. An event starts by its season's yearly dates (by_date, the default) and by any row of rotations that lists it: {key, period: day|week|month, events: [keys in turn order], offset_minutes, length_minutes, source} gives each period to the next event in the list, so one listed event is a plain daily, weekly or monthly event and rows overlap freely. No rotation ships: the wikis date every original event by the year, and the repeating shows (Bruce's concerts, the dance-off) are slots in world_events.json. Each event's mode is calendar, on or off; `realm event season <key> on|off|calendar|default` sets a hand toggle in the live world's event_overrides.json. Owner 2026-11-09: events stay once a year on real dates, no rotation ships, and an admin (the admin role only) can start or stop one at any time with realm <key> on|off|calendar|default (realm halloween on); the stock client keeps a line that starts with a slash to itself, so /<key> on is only for a client that sends it. A toggle of on or off holds until the event's next calendar edge (its next start or end by date or rotation) or until default clears it, whichever comes first; an event the calendar never moves keeps its toggle until cleared. (R) on_end: when an event is over a started quest is abandoned, unless its reward screen is open. forget_completed is off: a finished event quest stays finished, because forgetting it would lower the character's completed-quest count (the quest achievements) and the save has no field to remember it by; so a non-repeatable event quest is once per character. A repeatable one (repeatable and repeat_hours on its row) comes round again its hours after each run while its event runs. Shipped event quests carry their event's key in their own row's live_event (scripts/quest_fidelity.py moved the old quest_ids lists there).
